problems.title: E2.1 - Sum of Two Periodic Signals
problems.snippet: Analyzes the periodicity of the sum of two periodic discrete-time signals with different fundamental periods. Given \(x[n]\) with period \(p\) and \(y[n]\) with period \(q\), find the period of \(z[n] = x[n] + y[n]\). Explores how periods combine under addition using LCM concepts.

problems.title: E2.2 - Signal Fusion in Self-Driving Cars
problems.snippet: Applies Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization to sensor signals from LiDAR, Radar, and GPS to remove correlation. Given vectors \(a_1 = [1,1,0]^T\), \(a_2 = [-1,1,0]^T\), \(a_3 = [1,0,1]^T\), compute cosine similarities and apply Gram-Schmidt to obtain orthonormal basis \(\{q_1, q_2, q_3\}\).

problems.title: E2.3 - Robot Motion in 2D
problems.snippet: Studies 2D transformations using homogeneous coordinates. Given rotation matrix \(R(\pi/2)\) and translation \(T(3,2)\), examines non-commutativity of transformation compositions: \(TR \neq RT\).

problems.title: E2.4 - Subspace Properties
problems.snippet: Verifies orthonormality and decomposes vectors using orthonormal basis. Given \(\phi_1 = [1,1,1]^T/\sqrt{3}\), \(\phi_2 = [1,0,-1]^T/\sqrt{2}\), \(\phi_3 = [1,-2,1]^T/\sqrt{6}\), prove they form an orthonormal basis and decompose \(x = [3,4,12]^T\). Applies Parseval's theorem: \(||x||^2 = \sum |X_i|^2\).

problems.title: E2.5 - Discrete-Time Fourier Series
problems.snippet: Computes DTFS coefficients for a periodic signal with period \(p=4\). Given \(x[0]=2, x[1]=-1, x[2]=-1, x[3]=2\), find all coefficients \(X_k\) using \(X_k = (1/p)\sum x[n]e^{-jk\omega_0 n}\) where \(\omega_0 = 2\pi/p\). Express as \(x[n] = \alpha + \beta \cos(\pi n)\).

problems.title: E2.6 - Matching Null Spaces
problems.snippet: Proves the fundamental result \(N(A) = N(A^T A)\) by showing both subset inclusions. Uses norm properties and quadratic forms: \(||Ax||^2 = x^T(A^T A)x\). Important for understanding least squares and the normal equations \(A^T Ax = A^T b\).

problems.title: MT2.1 - Rotation! Rotation! Rotation!
problems.snippet: Studies rotation matrices and their powers. Shows \(R^{-1} = R^T\) for rotation matrix, proves \(R^n = R(n\theta)\), and analyzes spiral dynamics \(z(n) = (1/2)^n R(n\pi/2) z(0)\). The system combines rotation with exponential decay, creating an inward spiral to the origin.

problems.title: MT2.2 - Triangular Matrices
problems.snippet: Explores properties of triangular matrices. Proves upper-triangular \(U\) is invertible iff all diagonal entries are nonzero. For \(A = [[1,0,0],[2,0,0],[3,2,1]]\), finds bases for all four fundamental subspaces: \(N(A)\), \(C(A)\), \(N(A^T)\), \(C(A^T)\).

problems.title: MT2.3 - Solving Systems with Singular Matrices
problems.snippet: Analyzes \(Ax = b\) where \(A\) is singular. For \(A = [[1,-2],[3,-6]]\), explains why not invertible (\(\text{rank}(A) = 1\)), and determines when solutions exist. Shows \(b \in C(A)\) is necessary for consistency, and general solution has form \(x = x_p + x_n\) where \(x_n \in N(A)\).

problems.title: MT2.4 - QR Decomposition
problems.snippet: Applies Gram-Schmidt to decompose \(A = [[1,1,0],[1,1,1],[0,1,1]]\) into \(A = QR\). Verifies orthogonal matrix \(Q\) satisfies \(Q^T Q = I\), and determines upper-triangular \(R\) using \(R = Q^T A\).

problems.title: MT2.5 - DTFS
problems.snippet: Analyzes DTFS properties for periodic signals. For odd real-valued signal with period \(p\), proves \(X_{-k} = -X_k\) and \(X_k\) are purely imaginary. Computes all DTFS coefficients for signal with period 3, and expresses as sinusoidal form using Euler's formula.

problems.title: MT2.1 - Permutation Matrices
problems.snippet: Studies permutation matrices with exactly one 1 per row and column. Proves \(P^T P = I\) (orthogonality). For \(y = Px\), shows mean and variance are preserved: \(\mu_y = \mu_x\) and \(\sigma_y^2 = \sigma_x^2\). Computes \(PAP^T\) for simultaneous row/column permutation.

problems.title: MT2.2 - Correlation Coefficient
problems.snippet: Analyzes correlation coefficient \(\rho_{xy} = \langle \tilde{x}, \tilde{y} \rangle / (||\tilde{x}|| ||\tilde{y}||)\) for vectors in \(\mathbb{R}^2\). Proves \(\rho_{xy} = \pm 1\) always. For affine relationship \(y = \beta x + \gamma 1\), shows \(\rho_{xy} = \text{sgn}(\beta)\). Demonstrates any two such vectors can be expressed as affine functions of each other.

problems.title: MT2.3 - Gram-Schmidt Algorithm
problems.snippet: Applies Gram-Schmidt to \(a_1 = [1,0,0]^T\), \(a_2 = [0,1,1]^T\), \(a_3 = [1,0,1]^T\) to obtain orthonormal basis. Uses QR decomposition to solve \(Ax = b\) where \(b = [1, \sqrt{2}, \sqrt{2}]^T\) by computing \(Rx = Q^T b\) and back-substitution.

problems.title: MT2.4 - Projection Matrices
problems.snippet: Studies projection matrix \(P = aa^T/(a^T a)\) that projects onto \(\text{span}(a)\). Proves \(P^T = P\) (symmetric) and \(P^k = P\) (idempotent). For complementary projection \(S = I - P\), shows \(N(S) = \text{span}\{a\}\) and \(\text{rank}(S) = n-1\). Demonstrates \(S\) projects onto orthogonal complement.

problems.title: MT2.5 - Inner Products with Matrices
problems.snippet: Explores conditions for \(\langle x, y \rangle_W = x^T W y\) to be a valid inner product. Requires symmetry (\(W = W^T\)), positive-definiteness (\(x^T Wx > 0\) for \(x \neq 0\)), and invertibility. Shows \(W = [[2,1],[1,2]]\) is valid by writing \(x^T Wx = (1/2)(a-b)^2 + (3/2)(a+b)^2 \geq 0\).
